warnings.claim: Climate-related risks are identified and documented in a climate risk register that captures risk statements and supporting attributes for consistent assessment and ongoing monitoring.
Risk identification considers risks arising from the entity’s own operations and from the value chain.

Disclosures are provided in an integrated manner to avoid unnecessary duplication where oversight and monitoring are managed on an integrated basis through the climate risk register and its linkage to overall risk management.
The section describes processes used to identify, assess, prioritise and monitor climate-related risks and how those processes are integrated into overall risk management.
The report discloses processes used to identify, assess, prioritise and monitor sustainability-related opportunities.
warnings.policy: Kept as warning; factlock gate remains the blocker for unsupported numeric/entity claims.
